head: Vincent
harris
CEO
founder
body: “The Man Who Invented the Republican Internet”
[H4] —Bloomberg
“…a savvy digital whiz…”
[H4] — New York Times Magazine
Vincent Harris is CEO of Harris Media and has worked on numerous U.S. Presidential-level campaigns.
Harris ran the digital operations for the pro-Trump “Right for America” SuperPAC that was among the largest spenders on Google and Meta in the 2024 Presidential cycle. Previously, Vincent

ran digital operations for Kentucky Senator Rand Paul, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez (SuperPAC), Texas Governor Rick Perry, Arkansas Governor Mike Huckabee, and Speaker Newt Gingrich’s Presidential campaigns.

Vincent has also worked on head of state races across the world, including races in France, Spain, Albania, and Israel. Harris is proud of his work with Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party and spent extensive time in Israel in both the 2015 and 2022 successful election cycles for the Prime Minister. Harris Media and Vincent’s work internationally is unmatched in the political space.

Vincent spent over three years working with Ted Cruz, whom many have credited his successful use of the web as part of his incredible underdog win. Under Vincent’s watch, the nationally acclaimed firm, Harris Media, has grown into a successful company with offices in Texas, Florida, and New England. Vincent is a strong believer in the power of the internet as a tool to influence the public arena, and his firm’s successes have been noted in numerous publications and news outlets. He was named the youngest “Rising Star” in Politics by Campaigns & Elections Magazine and was recently profiled in Bloomberg, where he was dubbed “The Man Who Invented the Republican Internet.” Vincent
has appeared on numerous television channels including CNBC and the John Stossel show to discuss digital media trends.
[IMG] https://www.harrismediallc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/vincent-couch.jpg |
[H2] A LONG DIGITAL HISTORY

Vincent began his online activity in 2004 where he created a popular blog that was soon read by politicians and notables across Virginia. His blogging experience led him to the campaign of Governor Mike Huckabee, when he hopped on board his Presidential campaign, serving as one of two staffers specializing in online communications. Vincent traveled with the Governor from (as Gov. Huckabeee would say) “an asterisk in the polls” to Iowa Caucus winner, where he worked to organize blog interviews, gather content, and help the Governor’s campaign become one of the first to ever utilize Twitter. He organized the Iowa “Blogger Bash” on the eve of the Caucus that received national attention.

“Vincent was one of those special young men in whom I see remarkable potential. Humble and polite to the point of being over the top, he was incredibly talented in understanding the power of the Internet and the potential of using a blog to create a daily log of activities and information and to build an online community.” – An excerpt from Do the Right Thing (2008) by Gov. Mike Huckabee.

After Governor Huckabee bowed out of the race, Vincent spent two years working for Texas Senator John Cornyn where he oversaw an aggressive web outreach program on Sen. Cornyn’s re-election campaign, before being brought to direct the NRSC’s web operations.

Vincent led Harris Media to run daily operations for Governor Bob McDonnell in Virginia, a campaign which was noted by many in the press to be the first Republican campaign to embrace new media technology. Under his watch, the campaign raised over $1.4 million online.

During the 2010 cycle, Harris Media ran successful digital initiatives in 7 states, including having an instrumental role in the win of dark horse Rick Scott, who overcame all odds to narrowly win Florida’s gubernatorial race. Governor Scott’s innovative use of the web was featured in the National Review, numerous Florida papers/blogs, and even led to a case study by Facebook corporate.

Vincent was tapped in November 2011 to run digital operations for Texas Governor Rick Perry’s Presidential race. The unique and effective methods of online advertising Vincent utilized for the campaign were featured in ClickZ, AdAge, Politico, and earned Harris Media a spot as a finalist in Campaigns and Elections Reed Awards. The day after Governor Perry bowed out of the race, Harris Media was hired by Speaker Newt Gingrich in a digital role. Speaker Gingrich was the first Presidential candidate to adopt Facebook’s “Timeline” feature (both in a positive and contrasting light) which led to profiles on the popular social media site Mashable. Harris Media also designed and developed the Presidential candidate’s website at Newt.org.
[IMG] https://www.harrismediallc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/vincent-wall.jpg |
[H2] AN EXPERT

Vincent’s expertise concerning online advertising and digital communications is unmatched in the political space. He has been featured in the Examiner, Bloomberg, CNN, Mashable, Politico, The Richmond Times-Dispatch, Campaigns and Elections Magazine, the front page of the Washington Post, Fox News, Details Magazine, AdAge and Advertising Weekly. Vincent has been a guest lecturer at American University, the University of Texas, and has spoken at the National Federation of Republican Women, National Association of Attorneys General, the Trans-Atlantic Conference in Brussels, International Republican Institute in Turkey, Leadership Institute, Conservative Political Action Conference, and at the annual Shift Summit among others. He has participated in numerous radio interviews discussing the impact of technology on government. Vincent has a passion for international travel and has journeyed abroad numerous times to train political activists including two visits to post-Mubarak Egypt to train newly formed political parties on ways to mobilize and raise money online.
[IMG] https://www.harrismediallc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/vince-mitch.jpg |
[IMG] https://www.harrismediallc.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/vince-schmidt.jpg |
[H2] OFF THE CLOCK

Following in his grandfather’s footsteps, Vincent attended Baylor University in Waco, Texas where he met his wife Chelsea. Harris has an undergraduate degree from Baylor University and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin. Vincent and Chelsea enjoy playing tennis, reading, and spending time with their family.

head: Brian
Ruddle
VP of political
affairs
body: Brian Ruddle serves as the Vice President of Political Affairs at Harris Media. A graduate of the University of Colorado, Brian brings over a decade of experience in high-level campaigns, successfully managing efforts across local, state, and national elections. His expertise spans voter contact operations, ballot qualification, large-scale events, and digital media strategies, giving him a comprehensive approach to campaign management.

Before joining Harris Media, Brian was the Director of Political Training for the Republican National Committee, where he led nationwide organizational development initiatives. At Harris Media, Brian has delivered winning digital strategies for campaigns and organizations nationwide, including leading the Right for America PAC’s 2024 digital efforts, which supported President Trump in key battleground states.
Outside of work, Brian enjoys working on his golf game and spending time with his two dogs.

head: whitson
mize
Director of Creative &
Client Strategy
body: Whitson Mize is the Director of Creative and Client Strategy at Harris Media, bringing a dynamic blend of creativity and strategic vision to the team. A graduate of Full Sail University in Orlando, FL, with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Animation, Whit has a passion for illustration, animation, and design.

For the past two years, Whit has led Harris Media’s creative efforts, driving impactful design strategies for prominent political campaigns and organizations. His work includes leading the visual direction for the Right for America PAC’s 2024 digital campaign, supporting Francis Suarez through SOS America PAC, and collaborating with Benjamin Netanyahu, Prime Minister of Israel. Whit’s innovative approach ensures each project resonates with its audience and delivers measurable results.

head: Sean
Connaughton
Operations
Specialist
body: Born and raised in the Washington DC area, Sean comes to Harris Media as an experienced fundraiser for both non-profit organizations and political candidates at the local, state, and federal levels. With his extensive involvement in the targeting, prospecting, developing, and management of donor networks for multiple clients, Sean understands the details necessary to oversee a successful campaign finance program. Prior to that he spent 8 years on active duty in the United States Army.

After attending and successfully completing 4 years at the United States Military Academy (West Point), Sean was stationed at Fort Bragg, North Carolina as an Airborne Infantryman with the 82nd Airborne Division. He deployed to southern Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne Division as a part of Operation Freedom’s Sentinel in the Global War on Terrorism conducting combat operations in the Kandahar, Zabul, and Uruzgan provinces of TAAC-S (Train Advise Assist Command-South). Sean earned the Combat Infantryman Badge, the Army Commendation Medal with/Combat Device, as well as several other awards, badges, and recognitions.

In his spare time, Sean enjoys going to the gun range, golfing, working out, investing, and enduring the constant suffering & disappointment that is synonymous with being a lifelong fan of the New York Jets, Mets, and Islanders.

His strong attention to detail and organizational skills led to significant improvements in project delivery and operational efficiency.

At Harris Media, Yoel is responsible for crafting and executing comprehensive digital marketing strategies that have led to a significant increase in client engagement and retention. He is highly skilled in using data analytics to inform decision-making and has a passion for staying ahead of emerging digital trends.

In his spare time, Yoel enjoys exploring ways to develop his marketing skills. He has experience building websites and blogs, and he previously spent over five years making music, with more than four years of classical music training. Yoel has a keen interest in continuous learning, having earned a certification in Digital Marketing and E-Commerce from Google, and enjoys reading business books to stay updated on the latest industry trends. Fluent in both English and Spanish, Yoel is committed to fostering inclusive and impactful marketing campaigns that resonate across diverse audiences.

Fuera del trabajo, Alex se mantiene conectado con su fe, su familia y la música. Le encanta la música y se desempeña como Director Musical en su iglesia local (VOUS Church) los domingos, donde puede combinar su amor por la fe y la música cada semana.

head: Martina
Gornicki
Digital Media
Designer
body: Martina Gornicki was born in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and has spent the last seven years living between Brazil and Argentina. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Visual Arts from Universidade do Extremo Sul Catarinense (UNESC), studied two years of Image and Sound Design at the University of Buenos Aires (UBA), and has additional training in 2D digital animation and audiovisual content editing.

With more than six years of experience in the visual and audiovisual arts, Martina has earned multiple national audiovisual awards in Brazil, as well as academic recognitions from Santander Bank and CAPES (Brazil).
Since 2025, Martina has been part of the Harris Media team, where she works on visual and audiovisual projects for high-profile clients.

Outside of work, Martina enjoys playing volleyball, painting, going to live music shows, and spending time with friends and family. She has also traveled across several countries, an experience that enriches her aesthetic vision and professional perspective.

Martina Gornicki nació en Buenos Aires, Argentina, y ha vivido los últimos siete años entre Brasil y Argentina. Es licenciada en Artes Visuales por la Universidade do Extremo Sul Catarinense (UNESC), estudió dos años de Diseño de Imagen y Sonido en la Universidad de Buenos Aires (UBA) y cuenta con formación adicional en animación digital 2D y edición de contenido audiovisual.

Con más de seis años de experiencia en las artes visuales y audiovisuales, Martina ha recibido múltiples premios nacionales de audiovisuales en Brasil, así como reconocimientos académicos del Banco Santander y la CAPES (Brasil).
Desde 2025, Martina forma parte del equipo de Harris Media, donde trabaja en proyectos visuales y audiovisuales para clientes de alto perfil.

Fuera del trabajo, Martina disfruta jugando al voleibol, pintando, asistiendo a conciertos y pasando tiempo con amigos y familiares. También ha viajado por varios países, una experiencia que enriquece su visión estética y su perspectiva profesional.

Martina Gornicki nasceu em Buenos Aires, Argentina, e passou os últimos sete anos vivendo entre o Brasil e a Argentina. Ela é formada em Artes Visuais pela Universidade do Extremo Sul Catarinense (UNESC), cursou dois anos de Design de Imagem e Som na Universidade de Buenos Aires (UBA) e possui formação complementar em animação digital 2D e edição de conteúdo audiovisual.

Com mais de seis anos de experiência em artes visuais e audiovisuais, Martina conquistou diversos prêmios nacionais na área audiovisual no Brasil, além de reconhecimentos acadêmicos do Banco Santander e da CAPES (Colégio de Professores da Argentina).
Desde 2025, Martina integra a equipe da Harris Media, onde trabalha em projetos visuais e audiovisuais para clientes de renome.

Fora do trabalho, Martina gosta de jogar vôlei, pintar, ir a shows de música ao vivo e passar tempo com amigos e familiares. Ela também viajou por diversos países, uma experiência que enriquece sua visão estética e perspectiva profissional.

head: Francisco Tomas
Sanchez
Digital Media
Designer
body: Francisco brings his creativity to Harris Media by combining visual storytelling with generative artificial intelligence tools to produce dynamic campaigns optimized for social media. A university graduate with experience creating videos for clients in Argentina and Mexico, he adds a distinctive Latin American passion to the team. Beyond digital media, he has built a brief but notable career in short film directing and enjoys composing and playing music with his rock band.

Francisco aporta su creatividad a Harris Media combinando la narrativa visual con herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa para producir campañas dinámicas optimizadas para redes sociales. Graduado universitario con experiencia en la creación de videos para clientes en Argentina y México, añade una singular pasión latinoamericana al equipo. Además de su trabajo en medios digitales, ha desarrollado una breve pero destacada carrera como director de cortometrajes y disfruta componiendo e interpretando música con su banda de rock.

head: Rafael
Nunes
Digital Media
Designer
body: Rafael Nunes is a Brazilian video editor and graphic designer on Harris Media’s LATAM creative team. With experience in visual storytelling, he produces high-impact political videos that engage audiences, while also exploring generative AI tools to optimize workflows. Outside of work, Rafael finds inspiration in cultural and art exhibitions.

Rafael Nunes é um editor de vídeo e designer gráfico brasileiro que integra a equipe criativa da Harris Media na América Latina. Com experiência em narrativa visual, ele produz vídeos políticos de alto impacto que engajam o público, além de explorar ferramentas de IA generativa para otimizar fluxos de trabalho. Fora do trabalho, Rafael encontra inspiração em exposições culturais e artísticas.

head: Aldo
Quevedo
Web
Developer
body: Aldo was born in Mexicali, Mexico, and currently lives in Brazil. He is a passionate and dedicated developer with a strong focus on building modern, scalable, and visually engaging websites and web applications. His expertise spans across the MERN stack, WordPress, and Webflow.

With a strong command of technologies such as PHP, React, JavaScript, and various database systems, both relational and non-relational, Aldo enjoys crafting efficient and elegant solutions that enhance user experience and performance.

Originally graduating with honors as a Mechanical Engineer from UABC in Mexico, Aldo discovered his true passion in programming and decided to pursue it as his lifelong career. His background in engineering gives him a unique analytical approach to problem-solving and system design.

Outside of his professional work, Aldo has a deep love for learning new languages and exploring different cultures. He also enjoys watching movies and series, playing League of Legends, and spending quality time with his family.

Aldo nació en Mexicali, México, y actualmente vive en Brasil. Es un desarrollador apasionado y dedicado, enfocado en la creación de sitios web y aplicaciones modernas, escalables y visualmente atractivas. Su experiencia incluye el uso de la plataforma MERN, WordPress y Webflow.

Cuenta con un sólido dominio de tecnologías como PHP, React y JavaScript, así como de diversos sistemas de bases de datos, tanto relacionales como no relacionales. Aldo disfruta crear soluciones eficientes y elegantes que mejoran la experiencia del usuario y optimizan el rendimiento.

Se graduó con honores en Ingeniería Mecánica por la UABC en México. Durante su formación descubrió su verdadera pasión por la programación y decidió convertirla en su carrera profesional. Su formación en ingeniería le brinda un enfoque analítico único para la resolución de problemas y el diseño de sistemas.

Fuera del trabajo, tiene un gran interés por aprender nuevos idiomas y explorar diferentes culturas. También disfruta ver películas y series, jugar League of Legends y pasar tiempo de calidad con su familia.

Aldo nasceu em Mexicali, no México, e atualmente mora no Brasil. Ele é um desenvolvedor apaixonado e dedicado, com foco na criação de sites e aplicações web modernos, escaláveis e visualmente atraentes. Sua experiência abrange a stack MERN, WordPress e Webflow.

Com sólidos conhecimentos em tecnologias como PHP, React, JavaScript e diversos sistemas de bancos de dados, tanto relacionais quanto não relacionais, Aldo gosta de desenvolver soluções eficientes e elegantes que aprimoram a experiência do usuário e o desempenho das aplicações.

Formado com honras em Engenharia Mecânica pela UABC, no México, Aldo descobriu sua verdadeira paixão pela programação e decidiu transformá-la em sua carreira profissional. Sua formação em engenharia proporciona uma abordagem analítica diferenciada para a resolução de problemas e o desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Fora do ambiente profissional, Aldo tem um grande interesse em aprender novos idiomas e explorar diferentes culturas. Ele também gosta de assistir a filmes e séries, jogar League of Legends e passar momentos especiais com sua família.

head: Johnny
Benitez
Senior Creative Producer
/ Videographer
body: Johnny Benitez is a Senior Creative Producer / Videographer at Harris Media Group, where he combines creative storytelling with technical expertise to produce high-impact video and multimedia content. With over seven years of experience in digital production, Johnny has developed a diverse portfolio spanning branded campaigns, social media content, and long-form storytelling.

Before joining HMG, Johnny led creative efforts for agencies and organizations across South Florida. He has produced digital campaigns, managed media teams, and delivered fast-turnaround content that connects with audiences. His work reflects a passion for cinematic storytelling, sharp editing, and visual strategy that drives engagement and results.

Johnny Benítez es un productor creativo senior y videógrafo en Harris Media Group, donde combina la narrativa creativa con su experiencia técnica para producir contenido multimedia y de video de alto impacto. Con más de siete años de experiencia en producción digital, Johnny ha desarrollado un portafolio diverso que abarca campañas de marca, contenido para redes sociales y narrativas de larga duración.

Antes de unirse a HMG, Johnny lideró iniciativas creativas para agencias y organizaciones en el sur de Florida. Ha producido campañas digitales, gestionado equipos de medios y entregado contenido con plazos de entrega ajustados que conecta con el público. Su trabajo refleja una pasión por la narrativa cinematográfica, una edición precisa y una estrategia visual que impulsa la participación y genera resultados.

head: Ana
Leal
Account
Executive
body: Ana Leal was raised in Caracas, Venezuela, and is an Account Executive at HMG, where she contributes to digital campaigns, social media strategy, and content development for a diverse portfolio of clients. She graduated Cum Laude from Loyola University Chicago, earning a Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations and Advertising with a minor in Marketing.

With a strong foundation in strategic communications, Ana brings experience in digital content development, bilingual media outreach, and campaign coordination. Google Ads certified and recognized for her leadership and organizational skills, she is known for her ability to manage complex initiatives with precision, efficiency, and a results-driven mindset.

Inspired by HMG’s commitment to impactful storytelling, Ana is passionate about helping clients communicate clearly and authentically. She is dedicated to connecting with diverse audiences through thoughtful, data-informed messaging that drives engagement and meaningful impact.
Outside of work, Ana enjoys digital content creation, staying active, journaling, and spending quality time with family and friends.

Ana Leal creció en Caracas, Venezuela, y es ejecutiva de cuentas en HMG, donde contribuye a campañas digitales, estrategias en redes sociales y desarrollo de contenido para un portafolio diverso de clientes. Se graduó Cum Laude de Loyola University Chicago, obteniendo una Licenciatura en Relaciones Públicas y Publicidad con una especialización secundaria en Marketing.

Con una sólida formación en comunicaciones estratégicas, Ana cuenta con experiencia en desarrollo de contenido digital, gestión de medios bilingües y coordinación de campañas. Certificada en Google Ads y reconocida por sus habilidades de liderazgo y organización, se destaca por su capacidad para gestionar iniciativas complejas con precisión, eficiencia y una mentalidad orientada a resultados.

Inspirada por el compromiso de HMG con la narración de historias de impacto, Ana siente pasión por ayudar a los clientes a comunicarse de manera clara y auténtica. Está comprometida con conectar con audiencias diversas a través de mensajes estratégicos, respaldados por datos, que generan interacción y un impacto significativo.
Fuera del trabajo, Ana disfruta la creación de contenido digital, mantenerse activa, escribir en su diario y pasar tiempo de calidad con su familia y amigos.

head: Cayd
Wortman
Account
EXecutive
body: Cayd Wortman is an Account Executive at Harris Media LLC, where he supports statewide and local clients through full stack communications, grassroots execution, and digital strategy. Based in Waterville, Maine, Cayd brings a strong understanding of Maine voters and communities, pairing audience first messaging with creative content production that helps campaigns connect and perform.

A graduate of the New England School of Communications, Cayd holds a B.S. in Mass Communications, along with certificates in Web Media and Digital and Social Media Marketing. Prior to joining Harris Media in 2025, he served as Communications Manager for the University of Maine Alumni Association.

At Harris Media, Cayd’s work spans the full lifecycle of modern campaign communications, including designing campaign graphics and video content, scheduling and managing social media, writing and sending campaign emails, supporting fundraising efforts, and coordinating closely with campaign teams. He is also deeply involved in grassroots work, attending client events to capture authentic supporter footage and testimonials, and supporting ballot access efforts through on the ground signature gathering.Outside of work, Cayd embraces Maine’s outdoors and simple living. He enjoys time in the woods, fishing, golfing, hiking, and snowmobiling whenever he can.

head: Tracy
Ramos
Account
Coordinator
body: Tracy Ramos is an Account Coordinator at Harris Media Group. He holds a B.A. in English and a minor in journalism from the University of Miami, using his background in communication to run digital campaigns, paid advertising, and email strategy.

Tracy has managed multi-channel operations for one gubernatorial race, two congressional campaigns, government entities, and non-profit organizations. Leveraging tools like WinRed, NationBuilder, and Canva, he oversees everything from daily social media content to overall campaign strategy.

head: Joey
Munroe
Account
Coordinator
body: Raised in Florida, Joseph is an Account Coordinator at Harris Media LLC, where he helps manage digital campaigns, social media strategy, and content development. He graduated from the University of Florida with a Bachelor’s degree in Journalism and Communications and is currently working toward becoming a “double-Gator” while pursuing his Master’s degree in Public Relations at UF. He pairs this academic foundation with firsthand political communications experience, having previously interned in Washington, D.C., for Congressman Byron Donalds.

Drawn to Harris Media’s mission and values, Joseph brings a strategic, fast-paced approach to his work, combining a sharp understanding of media relations with a passion for compelling storytelling. He looks forward to driving client success by crafting high-impact digital campaigns that connect with audiences and leave a lasting impression.
Outside of work, he enjoys playing sports, hanging out with friends, and channeling his creativity into producing engaging social media content.

head: Paige
Manning
Account
Coordinator
body: Paige Manning is an Account Coordinator at Harris Media LLC, where she contributes to digital campaigns, social media strategies, and content development for a diverse portfolio of clients. She looks forward to learning more about the political media landscape and continuing to grow her skills in digital strategy, communications, and campaign work.

She recently graduated from the University of Miami, earning a Bachelor of Business Administration degree with a major in marketing and a minor in advertising. She is originally from New Jersey, but now calls Miami home. Prior to Harris Media, she worked as a Digital Marketing Coordinator for Airoyal Company, where she generated sales leads, executed targeted email marketing campaigns, and managed digital content across LinkedIn and other marketing channels.
Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with friends and family, going on walks, traveling, trying new restaurants, and enjoying everything Miami has to offer.

head: Thibaud
Frappier
Video Editor &
Videographer
body: Thibaud Frappier is part of the creative and marketing team at Harris Media Group, where he works on visual production and marketing strategy for high-profile candidates.

He brings more than 5 years of experience in social media marketing and content strategy, built running his own agency and through previous roles managing multi-platform content for brand and personal accounts.

He was selected for Founder’s Camp, a highly competitive, Y Combinator-style program hosted at the Artificial Intelligence Center at Miami Dade College, where he studied startup fundamentals alongside sessions led by Airbnb co-founder Brian Chesky and Y Combinator co-founder Paul Graham, placing 2nd overall at the program’s final showcase.

Raised in Miami, Thibaud is currently pursuing a degree in International Business at Florida International University and is bilingual in English and French. Outside of work, he’s traveled to several different countries and enjoys playing soccer and going to live music festivals.

head: Hector
Alarcon
Video Editor &
Videographer
body: Hector Alarcon is a Video Editor & Videographer at Harris Media Group, bringing relentless creative energy and a sharp visual instinct to every project he touches. Driven by a passion for filmmaking and storytelling, Hector thrives in fast-paced environments, transforming ideas into powerful, attention-grabbing content with precision, creativity, and speed.

At HMG, Hector produces high-impact content for political and advocacy campaigns, from rapid-response creative and social media storytelling to cinematic campaign pieces. Known for his work ethic, attention to detail, and constant pursuit of the next great idea, he is always shooting, editing, experimenting, and pushing his craft forward,with one goal: create work that moves fast, hits hard, and is impossible to ignore.

Hector Alarcon es editor de video y videógrafo en Harris Media Group, donde aporta una energía creativa incansable y un sólido instinto visual a cada proyecto. Impulsado por su pasión por el cine y la narrativa audiovisual, Hector se destaca en entornos de ritmo acelerado, transformando ideas en contenido poderoso y capaz de captar la atención con precisión, creatividad y rapidez.

En HMG, Hector produce contenido de alto impacto para campañas políticas y de incidencia pública, desde piezas de respuesta rápida y contenido para redes sociales hasta producciones de estilo cinematográfico. Reconocido por su ética de trabajo, atención al detalle y constante búsqueda de nuevas ideas, siempre está grabando, editando, experimentando y llevando su creatividad al siguiente nivel, con un solo objetivo: crear contenido que se mueva rápido, impacte fuerte y sea imposible de ignorar.

head: Esteban
Guillen
Video Editor &
Videographer
body: Esteban Guillen is a Video Editor & Videographer at Harris Media, where he merges visionary storytelling with cutting-edge innovation to craft transformative, high-impact digital experiences. With over 10 years of relentless dedication to the creative arts, he has curated a dynamic portfolio spanning bold brand evolutions, immersive campaigns, and purpose-driven narratives. Before joining Harris Media, Esteban spearheaded pioneering creative initiatives across the world, empowering elite teams to push the boundaries of design and deliver masterful content. His work reflects a profound dedication to striking visual mastery and a bold strategic vision that doesn’t just drive engagement, it inspires action and shapes culture.

Esteban Guillen es editor de video y videógrafo en Harris Media, donde combina una narrativa visionaria con innovación de vanguardia para crear experiencias digitales transformadoras y de alto impacto. Con más de 10 años de dedicación constante a las artes creativas, ha desarrollado un portafolio dinámico que abarca grandes evoluciones de marca, campañas inmersivas y narrativas impulsadas por un propósito. Antes de unirse a Harris Media, Esteban lideró iniciativas creativas pioneras alrededor del mundo, empoderando a equipos de élite para superar los límites del diseño y crear contenido de gran calidad. Su trabajo refleja una profunda dedicación al dominio visual y una visión estratégica audaz que no solo impulsa el engagement, inspira a la acción y contribuye a moldear la cultura.

head: Tonny
Zheng
Account
Coordinator
body: Tonny Zheng is an Account Coordinator at Harris Media with a background in digital marketing, advertising, and client strategy. He earned his Bachelor of Science in Marketing from Florida International University and has experience managing paid media campaigns, CRM systems, email marketing, and marketing automation.

Tonny Zheng es coordinador de cuentas en Harris Media y cuenta con experiencia en marketing digital, publicidad y estrategia para clientes. Obtuvo su Licenciatura en Ciencias de Marketing en Florida International University y tiene experiencia gestionando campañas de publicidad digital, sistemas CRM, email marketing y automatización de marketing.

head: Jordan
Kragness
Account
EXecutive
body: Originally from Detroit, Michigan, Jordan Kragness is a Cinematographer and Filmmaker based in Miami, where he bridges cinematic filmmaking and high-converting video marketing. Bringing a sharp eye and a strong work ethic to every production, he has lensed and directed content for high-profile clients and media enterprises, including Valuetainment, Grant Cardone, and Jay Roberts. Jordan pairs his deep technical craft in camera operating, editing, and post production with a strategic marketing approach.

Drawn to Harris Media’s mission and values, he is proud to be part of a team pushing the boundaries of digital media. He looks forward to contributing to something bigger as the agency drives impact for its clients. Outside of work, Jordan enjoys training MMA, hanging out with his dog, and continuing to write and direct his own independent films.

head: Brooks
Steier
Account
Coordinator
body: Brooks Steier is an Account Coordinator at Harris Media LLC, where he supports digital advertising and communications for political campaigns across the country. Raised in Louisville, Kentucky, he graduated from Southern Methodist University with a degree in Political Science and additional coursework in Sports Management.

Brooks has years of experience working on campaigns across Kentucky and Texas. He got his start in grassroots politics with the Jefferson County Republican Party, working in voter outreach, field operations, and fundraising for campaigns including Daniel Cameron, Matt Bevin, Mitch McConnell, and President Donald Trump. He later volunteered on Governor Greg Abbott’s 2022 reelection campaign in Texas.
Drawn to Harris Media’s reputation for innovative political strategy, Brooks saw an opportunity to build on his campaign experience while continuing to learn and grow in the digital side of politics.
Outside of work, he enjoys golfing, watching Kentucky Basketball, following politics and current events, and spending time with friends and family.

head: Maria
Giron
Account
Executive
body: Maria Giron is an Account Executive at Harris Media, where she works on digital communications, content development, strategic messaging, and campaign execution for clients. Born in Bogotá, Colombia, she moved to Miami in 2012 and has since built her academic and professional career in South Florida.

Maria earned her degree in Statistics from Florida International University and later completed two master’s degrees, one in Finance and another in Marketing, from Southeastern Oklahoma State University. Her diverse academic background gives her a unique perspective that combines analytical thinking, financial knowledge, and creative strategy. At Harris Media, she has enjoyed the opportunity to apply those skills in the fast-paced world of political communications while continuing to expand her experience in campaigns, advocacy, and digital strategy.

Outside of work, Maria enjoys staying active through the gym and Pilates. She also enjoys recording videos as a creative outlet and is a big fan of rock music. Whether she is working on a new project, pursuing a personal goal, or exploring a creative interest, she is always looking for opportunities to learn, grow, and challenge herself.

Maria Giron es Ejecutiva de Cuentas en Harris Media, donde trabaja en comunicaciones digitales, desarrollo de contenido, mensajes estratégicos y ejecución de campañas para clientes. Nacida en Bogotá, Colombia, se mudó a Miami en 2012 y desde entonces ha desarrollado su trayectoria académica y profesional en el sur de Florida.

Maria obtuvo su título en Estadística en Florida International University y posteriormente completó dos maestrías, una en Finanzas y otra en Marketing, en Southeastern Oklahoma State University. Su diversa formación académica le brinda una perspectiva única que combina el pensamiento analítico, el conocimiento financiero y la estrategia creativa. En Harris Media, ha disfrutado la oportunidad de aplicar estas habilidades en el dinámico mundo de las comunicaciones políticas, mientras continúa ampliando su experiencia en campañas, promoción de causas y estrategia digital.

Fuera del trabajo, Maria disfruta mantenerse activa yendo al gimnasio y practicando Pilates. También le gusta grabar videos como una forma de expresión creativa y es una gran fanática de la música rock. Ya sea trabajando en un nuevo proyecto, persiguiendo una meta personal o explorando un interés creativo, siempre busca oportunidades para aprender, crecer y desafiarse a sí misma.

head: Giovanni
Medina
Video
Editor
body: Giovanni Medina was born in Cali, Colombia. He holds a degree in Digital Communication from Universidad Autónoma de Occidente and has spent the last eight years working in audiovisual production and video editing.

Throughout his career, Giovanni has worked across a variety of industries, including television, government communications, educational content, digital marketing, and film production. His experience includes video editing, motion graphics, content creation, and audiovisual storytelling for both public and private organizations.

Before joining Harris Media in 2026, Giovanni collaborated with production companies, government institutions, and digital agencies, helping create engaging content for diverse audiences. He is passionate about visual communication and enjoys finding creative ways to tell compelling stories through video.

Giovanni Medina nació en Cali, Colombia. Es profesional en Comunicación Digital de la Universidad Autónoma de Occidente y ha dedicado los últimos ocho años al desarrollo de proyectos de producción audiovisual y edición de video.

A lo largo de su trayectoria profesional, Giovanni ha trabajado en diversos sectores, incluyendo televisión, comunicación gubernamental, contenido educativo, marketing digital y producción cinematográfica. Su experiencia abarca la producción y edición de contenidos audiovisuales. Antes de unirse a Harris Media en 2026, colaboró con entidades como la Alcaldía de Santiago de Cali, Telepacífico, Crehana, Hello ID México y diversas productoras audiovisuales.

En Harris Media, Giovanni contribuye a la creación de contenido visual de alto impacto que ayuda a los clientes a comunicar sus mensajes de manera efectiva y a conectar con sus audiencias en entornos digitales.
Fuera del ámbito profesional, disfruta practicar deporte, mantenerse activo y explorar nuevas tecnologías y herramientas creativas que potencian la narrativa audiovisual y los procesos de producción.

head: Ana
Marciliano
Video
Editor
body: Ana Laura Roma is a Video Editor with more than 12 years of experience. Originally from Brazil and based in Buenos Aires since 2017, she has worked with clients across Latin America, Europe, and the United States, bringing a multicultural perspective to every project.
Outside of work, she enjoys aerial acrobatics and photography, creative pursuits that continue to inspire her visual storytelling.

Ana Laura Roma es Editora de Video, con más de 12 años de experiencia. Originaria de Brasil y radicada en Buenos Aires desde 2017, ha trabajado con clientes de toda América Latina, Europa y Estados Unidos, aportando una perspectiva multicultural a cada proyecto.
Fuera del trabajo, disfruta de la acrobacia aérea y la fotografía, actividades creativas que continúan inspirando su narrativa visual.

Ana Laura Roma é Editora de Vídeo, com mais de 12 anos de experiência. Natural do Brasil e radicada em Buenos Aires desde 2017, ela já trabalhou com clientes de toda a América Latina, Europa e Estados Unidos, trazendo uma perspectiva multicultural para cada projeto.
Fora do trabalho, Ana Laura gosta de praticar acrobacia aérea e fotografia, atividades criativas que continuam a inspirar sua narrativa visual.

head: Gabriela
Camelo
Video
Editor
body: Gabriela (or Gaby) is a Video Editor at Harris Media LLC. Born and raised in Bogotá, Colombia, she holds a degree in Social Communication and Journalism and is passionate about video editing and social media management. She is known for being a highly creative professional with a constant curiosity that motivates her to learn new things every day.
Outside of work, she enjoys traveling, listening to music, and spending quality time with her friends and family.

Gabriela (o Gaby) es una editora de video en Harris Media LLC. Nacida y criada en Bogotá, Colombia. Es graduada en Comunicación Social y Periodismo, apasionada por la edición de video y la gestión de redes sociales. Se caracteriza por ser una profesional sumamente creativa y con una curiosidad constante que la motiva a aprender cosas nuevas cada día.
Fuera del ámbito laboral, disfruta viajar, escuchar música y compartir tiempo de calidad con sus amigos y su familia.

head: Avery
Levinger
Operations
Manager
body: Avery Levinger serves as Operations Manager at Harris Media, guiding operational strategy and overseeing the company’s internal operations. Avery focuses on aligning people, processes, and resources with the company’s goals, strengthening internal systems, and translating priorities into practical plans.

Avery brings experience across higher education and the sports & entertainment industry, including work with the World Baseball Classic and FIFA World Cup. This varied background informs Avery’s strategic, adaptable approach to solving problems, coordinating teams, and building the operational foundation that allows Harris Media to deliver for its clients.
Originally from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Avery enjoys spending time with his dog and watching and playing sports, particularly football and soccer.

Avery Levinger se desempeña como Gerente de Operaciones en Harris Media, donde dirige la estrategia operativa y supervisa las operaciones internas de la empresa. Avery se enfoca en alinear al personal, los procesos y los recursos con los objetivos de la compañía, fortalecer los sistemas internos y transformar las prioridades en planes prácticos y concretos.

Avery cuenta con experiencia en los sectores de la educación superior, el deporte y el entretenimiento, incluyendo su participación en proyectos relacionados con el Clásico Mundial de Béisbol (World Baseball Classic) y la Copa Mundial de la FIFA. Esta trayectoria diversa influye en su enfoque estratégico y adaptable para resolver problemas, coordinar equipos y construir una estructura operativa sólida que permita a Harris Media ofrecer resultados de calidad a sus clientes.
Originario de Pittsburgh, Pensilvania, Avery disfruta pasar tiempo con su perro, así como ver y practicar deportes, especialmente el fútbol americano y el fútbol.
